sections.title: About the studio
sections.subtitle: Sample text — replace me: A spare room in {{city}}, a design wall, and a printer that has seen too many nested templates.

sections.html:
I wrote patterns for my own guild first, because the published geese I liked never quite nested. The first PDF sold to people I already knew. The rest followed from workshops.

Teaching is still the better part of the year. Pattern math happens on the weeks in between.
